ops.title: detours FP tracked end-to-end: reviewer outage diagnosis + 9.18.0 sweep/anchor wave
ops.body:
**Question (user):** did the cc-orchestrate detours false positive (agent dismissed the flag in-text, 2026-07-15T21:36Z, session c18b00de) track against a capt-hook continuous-improvement fix?

**Answer: yes, fully.** The FIX lane created candidate #11629 (fix/watching, misfire_class=false_positive, target general.detours) at 22:13Z via a sibling-session dir sweep — 37 min after the incident, while the session was still open — and the judge accepted it at 22:23Z (verdict 3267, misfire_confirmed, 0.82, fidelity=full). It was invisible at first check only because (a) ingestion ran solely at session boundaries and the session never ended, and (b) the reviewer was quiet 05:32→22:13Z on 07-15: overnight machine sleep (spawn.log codex network burst at 05:48Z = sleep onset) compounded by the consumer plugin cache frozen at 9.10.0 (fixed by the 9.16.0 wave, note 487560ca). One SessionEnd (captain-hook c1ebc792, 21:36Z) was genuinely missed with heartbeat-proven delivery and zero trace — root cause unprovable pre-breadcrumbs; leading suspect is a torn .venv during a concurrent uv sync.

**Shipped in 9.18.0** (commits above + 7a042c35 markers, f0aa0551 docs, 1bbd3ded manifest, 48196507 dogfood wiring):
- W0: scan.py exit_plan_rejection gating no longer dataclasses.replace()es cc-transcript v14 native-view events (this was live-bricking cc-transcript repo reviews — spawn_runs row 544); guard breadcrumbs on every silent exit; child start log line; spawn_deadline_seconds=7200 pass deadline; brain_deadline_seconds=3600 subprocess kill (brain_exit=-9) — review finding: asyncio.timeout cannot govern the blocking brain subprocess.
- W1: Stop-triggered `capt-hook review sweep` — file-stamp claim-first throttle (sweeps/<sha256(cwd)[:12]>.{trigger,sweep}, 30min default), full scan/triage/judge, hard brain+PR-sync exclusion. Ingest re-scan of growing transcripts verified idempotent (three dedup layers) and regression-locked.
- W2: UserMessages prompt context (first prompt + last 4 user prompts, required=True) anchors the detours judge on the authorization record; label="detours" stable identity (prompt edits no longer rotate hook_name); prompt rewritten around evidence authority; long-session inline tests.
- W3: classify_marker vocab +warning, markers +false_alarm (flag/flagged/alert deliberately excluded).

**Ops:** candidate #11629 armed (pr_open→accepted, resolved_at 2026-07-16T01:20Z) — reopen_recurrent_fixes watches for post-fix recurrence; post-fix complaints land on the new detours:llm_nudge_detours identity as fresh candidates (accepted caveat).

**Open residuals:** (1) CREATE-lane extract_correction runs at INGEST time and a dead LLM backend (codex quota until Jul 22) fails the whole scan pass ok=0 — evidence capture shouldn't need a live LLM; candidate for a follow-up wave. (2) CHANGELOG 9.18.0 entry deferred — the shared file carries another session's uncommitted 9.17.0 entry. (3) Two pytest failures are that same codex quota (TestSlugRegroupE2E, TestCrossDetectorCollapseIngest). (4) One stray pre-wiring "sweep skip" breadcrumb in the real spawn.log during a pytest run — unreproduced, observability-only.
